correctness.rationale: For iid uniform q>=2 letters, each radius-threshold event imposes mirrored equality edges forming a matching. Two different center reflection matchings have acyclic union: alternating two reflections translate by a nonzero integer, impossible on a finite cycle. Forest label equalities factor q^{-(r+s)}, so all two-center upper tails and hence radius variables are independent. Tail-sum moments give V_m and exact even/odd center-capacity multiplicities; finite generating-function algebra yields the stated rational variance series, and V_m=q/(q-1)^2+O_q(mq^{-m}) gives slope 2q/(q-1)^2. Explicit n=1 and n=2 boundaries, occurrence-vs-distinct distinction and 3-center dependence are properly handled. A fresh exact enumeration matched 21 (q,n) cases; that is corroboration, not the proof.
